required_contexts_source: derived at plan time from the frozen workflow contract (scripts/ci/contract-conformance.mjs); never hand-listed here

identity.law: nothing is baked into the image; identity is the runtime env chain read by server/_core/buildIdentity.ts

process.workers: none (single process; background jobs in-process; DISABLE_BACKGROUND_JOBS=1 law for any extra replica)
process.jobs: CronJobRunner in-process; overlap guard is per-process memory — numReplicas MUST stay 1 without a distributed lock

migration.law: db-push.yml runs BEFORE any dependent code deploy (deploy-order hazard #370)
migration.apply_command: pnpm db:push (drizzle-kit generate + reconciled-migrate MODE=apply CONFIRM=RECONCILE)

receipt.mechanism: CI_VERIFY_DBPUSH_RUN_ID env var carrying a db-push.yml run id
receipt.trigger: any added drizzle/*.sql between base and head
receipt.known_limit: receipt is local/deterministic; operator verifies the run id targets this branch (recorded residual risk)

migration.drift_oracle: drizzle-kit generate must be a no-op against the committed chain (p09 schemaDriftGate)
migration.rollback_limit: no automatic schema rollback; migrations are forward-only (0000-0134); application rollback requires backward-compatible schema
migration.chain: drizzle/ forward-only, journal-validated by scripts/reconciled-migrate.mjs (hash+timestamp multiset, fails closed)

targets.discovery: provider from repository metadata (railway.json) + recorded read-only live snapshot; ambiguity blocks

production.auto_deploy: push to main deploys (merge to main IS a production deploy)
production.builder_note: repo railway.json pins DOCKERFILE; live service config read 2026-08-13 reported builder RAILPACK/V3 — railway.json takes precedence when present; divergence recorded as residual risk
production.execution: REFUSED_WITHOUT_AUTHORIZATION_RECEIPT; production execution is NOT enabled in this qualification

rehearsal.why: the Railway project has NO non-production environment (verified read-only 2026-08-13); creating one is prohibited (create no infrastructure). The local Docker daemon + repo Dockerfile + digest-bound MySQL fixture are the existing, verified non-production target (the p08 cleanroom).
rehearsal.database: disposable MySQL fixture, digest recorded in docs/verification/evidence/p08/P08-ENTRY.json; migrations replayed via pnpm db:migrate:reconciled

variables.law: names only; values are never captured, printed, or persisted

rollout.strategy: single-replica cutover behind /health gating (previous deploy keeps serving on 503)
rollout.post_deploy_verification: deploy-smoke.yml on push (240s settle, 3 attempts) via the Cloudflare-fronted origin with x-dime-agent bypass; never the raw Railway origin

rollback.mechanism: redeploy the prior successful artifact (Railway prior deployment / local prior image)
rollback.known_limit: no automatic production rollback exists; /health 503 keeping the previous deploy is the only automatic protection

authorization.law: production execution requires a receipt; no receipt means refusal; this qualification NEVER executes production

leases.law: one active deployment operation per target; lease binds target, candidate, artifact, run, operator, expiry, idempotency key

evidence.retention: journals and certificates are append-only; failed evidence is never overwritten
evidence.forbidden: secret values, tokens, passwords, .env contents, raw customer data
